name: Deep Rail Mining Cart
description: Small rail carts running on narrow-gauge track in the deep Underworld mining tunnels. Nobody knows who laid the track or when. The carts are mechanically simple — gravity and electric assist, manual braking, no lights. Underworld explorers and miners use them to cover distance in the deep tunnels, screaming through the dark on rails they can't see, trusting that the track ahead is intact because it was intact last time. Sometimes it isn't.
propulsion: Gravity (downhill), electric chain-pull (uphill), manual pump on some lines
speed: Variable — gravity runs can exceed 60 km/h on steep grades
range: Track-dependent. Some lines run for kilometers.
autonomy: Manual only. There is no automation in the deep.
armament: None. A lantern if you're lucky.
common_usage: Deep Underworld traversal, mining operations, exploration, flight from things that live in the dark.
story_hooks: A mining cart arrives at an upper station with no one aboard — but the brake is set and the cargo is neatly loaded
The track in the deep tunnels branches into a line that goes straight down at a 45-degree angle, and something is coming up it
